about_the_game:
Inspired by the ancient myth of Sisyphus, you are tasked with pushing a gigantic boulder up a hill. Reach each checkpoint before the rising water swallows you whole.

Consider this either as a puzzle where the puzzle is getting from point A to point B on a desolate landscape together with a hard-to-control oversized rolling rock. Or consider this a racing game where you rush over the same set of islands competing against growing rate of water increase.

Full disclosure: this game is largely a one person operation that is developed during spare time. There will be bugs and oddities. There are plans for both QoL and content updates, but without any overly specific timeline. Nonetheless the core functionality is there which is why I will not be labeling this early access, limited demo, etc.

If you do purchase the game, glad to have you on board and let's see where the boulder rolls.

linux_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Ubuntu 22.04+
  • Processor: Intel Xeon E5-1630 v4 3,7GHz
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GeForce RTX 2060
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Any on-board chip will work.
  • Additional Notes: The above requirements have been verified to work, but it is possible the game will work on lower specs.
